edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: Late his R resets fights and E kites your entry — only a flank one-shot before Chronobreak is up works.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Assassin's Path like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1 — it erases your kill and heals him, so bait it, reset, and re-engage inside that window. - Parallel Convergence is 22s: no anomaly means no stun and no shield. - Timewinder is 9s — his shove and his poke die with it down.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: Crash the wave before you leave — Ekko's Timewinder clears it back fast, and a bounced wave costs plates while you commute.

edits.before: Ekko burns Chronobreak on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Ekko burns Chronobreak on nothing — that window is 110 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: Fighting while Chronobreak, the W anomaly, and Phase Dive are all live is dueling his whole timeline.

edits.before: Stack passive third-hit for the stun burst
edits.after: Stack the third-hit passive for burst speed
